editorial_policy: The 50 slots are a comparative design target, not 50 psychometrically independent scored items.
REPLACE_FOR_EXCLUDED_OR_DUPLICATE_SLOT has a NEW candidate ID, and must NOT overwrite the semantic meaning of an original ID.
Left/right alternatives share resource/effort constraints whenever possible; remaining confounds need review.
B 12 and C 12 cases heavily share core judgment and may not warrant 12 independently scored items.
C-FU14/C-FU15 are a study contrast pair in prior form, not individually calibrated random-sampling items; alternative proposals don't validate prior pairing.

E fixed two items, with bipolar vs independent response structure remaining a separately tested choice; current 50-slot illustration uses two bipolar 7-point proposals to avoid silently changing scoring contracts.
